preconditions: root anchor supplies all six rigid-body restraint classes
constant-effort support declares exactly one translational restraint UY and a finite positive constant load
variable-spring stiffness uses rotational DOF RZ and N*m/rad
movement limits are finite positive lengths
root anchor leaves the cantilever stable whether the one-way RZ support is active or inactive
one-way is an existing accepted nonlinear class
initial state and activation sense are explicit
nodal RZ load has moment dimension and N*m unit
rotational_nonlinear.uncertainty: active-set convergence and final state are unexecuted until frozen-candidate CLI run; exact signatures are emitted for a completed nonlinear solve regardless of final active/inactive state

preconditions: genuine pressure requires category=pressure, dimension=pressure and an element target
finite zero pressure makes pressure_for_pipe return Some(0)
zero pressure makes pressure thrust sum 0 so pressure_thrust_active is false
stress recovery must retain Some(0) pressure components
zero_pressure_longitudinal.uncertainty: source-derived reachability probe only; the exact row has no actual product-output witness and must remain unresolved until the frozen-candidate CLI run

qualification_rule: A signature passes only when the frozen candidate CLI exits successfully, mechanics status equals MECHANICS_SOLVED, and at least one actual mechanics_envelope.results row matches all three exact fields. Prepared inputs and source-derived expectations are not a pass.
